description: This file defines the ADODB_odbtp class, which implements a database driver for the ODBTP protocol within the ADODB PHP database abstraction library. It includes methods for connecting, executing SQL commands, handling transactions, sequences, and preparing statements. It also defines various specialized record set classes for different database types.
external_files: odbtp.dll or shared object (implicitly referenced via functions)

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp
classes.description: Driver class implementing database connection and operation methods for the ODBTP protocol within ADODB.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp
classes.description: Base class for record set results from ODBTP queries, with subclasses for specific database types.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_mssql
classes.description: Record set class specialized for Microsoft SQL Server via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_access
classes.description: Record set class specialized for MS Access via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_vfp
classes.description: Record set class specialized for Visual FoxPro via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_oci8
classes.description: Record set class specialized for Oracle OCI8 via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_sybase
classes.description: Record set class specialized for Sybase via ODBTP.

methods.name: ADODB_odbtp
methods.description: Constructor for the driver class.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server attribute information such as name and version.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns last error message from the connection.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity/auto-increment ID.

methods.description: Returns number of affected rows by last operation.

methods.description: Creates a new sequence in the database.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates and returns a new sequence ID.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database.

methods.name: MetaTables

methods.name: MetaColumns

methods.description: Begins a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
